entries.note: The sender dropped the parcel at a pickup point.

entries.wording: ENTREGUE À DPD PELO PONTO DE ENTREGA
entries.note: The pickup point handed the parcel to DPD.
Collected by the courier; after a pickup-point drop-off or a depot scan it is a hand-over in transit.
Scanned in at a depot on the way.
Scanned in at the depot before delivery.

entries.wording: HORÁRIO DE ENTREGA ENVIADA AO DESTINATÁRIO
entries.note: A message giving the recipient a delivery window, which the comment column shows; it is not a scan.
A message telling the recipient of the next delivery; it is not a scan.
The expected delivery day, relayed by DPD Germany beside the depot's intake; it is not a scan.

entries.wording: ENDEREÇO DO DESTINATÁRIO INCORRECTO OU DESCONHECIDO
entries.note: Not delivered because the address is wrong or unknown; the parcel went out again.

entries.wording: ENDEREÇO DO DESTINATÁRIO INCOMPLETO OU ILEGÍVEL
entries.note: Not delivered because the address is incomplete or unreadable.
The recipient was not in.
The recipient was closed for holidays.
The locker or pickup point was full; the parcel went to another point.
Back at the depot to go out again.
Back at the depot after a failed attempt, not a return to the sender.
Held at the depot.
A request for a new delivery, not a movement.
A request to change the address, not a movement.
The sender corrected the address after a failed attempt.

entries.wording: ENTREGUE PELA DPD NO PONTO DE ENTREGA
entries.note: The driver left the parcel at a pickup point or locker for the recipient.
The pickup point took the parcel in; the comment column names the point.

entries.wording: DATA DE PERMANÊNCIA EM LOJA EXPIRADA
entries.note: Nobody collected the parcel at the pickup point in time.
A return to the sender ordered; the proof of delivery after it is the delivery back to the sender.
Proof of delivery; the comment column names who received the parcel. After a return to the sender is ordered, the parcel is returned.
